description.subtitle: Manchester United adidas Home Women's Jersey 2025 2026 - Red
description.tagline: Red Devil style with a perfect fit for you
description.intro: Experience the excitement of Old Trafford with the new adidas Manchester United 2025/2026 jersey for women. Designed for true fans, it combines comfort, style and Red Devils pride. Its technical fabric and slim fit allow you to cheer or play freely. Make it yours and stand out in the United colors!
key_benefits: Authentic Manchester United design: Based on the official kit of the 2025/2026 season.
Adapted to the female body: Slim fit that fits comfortably to your silhouette.
Breathable technical fabric: Maintains freshness even in the most intense moments.
Ideal for day to day or the stadium: Wear it both in matches and in your casual looks.
Commitment to the environment: Made with high quality recycled polyester.

Diseñada para las verdaderas fans, combina comodidad, estilo y orgullo por los Red Devils. Su tejido técnico y corte entallado te permiten animar o jugar con libertad. ¡Hazla tuya y destaca con los colores del United!
key_benefits: Diseño auténtico del Manchester United: Basado en la equipación oficial de la temporada 2025/2026.
Adaptada al cuerpo femenino: Corte entallado que se ajusta cómodamente a tu silueta.
Tejido técnico transpirable: Mantiene la frescura incluso en los momentos de más intensidad.
Ideal para el día a día o el estadio: Lúcela tanto en partidos como en tus looks casual.
